channel.title: Contractor UK Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Contractor UK Limited (contractoruk.com)

item.title: Contracting Awards 2026 opens for entries — with new AI category
item.description: ‘Hard workers. Innovation-embracers. Value-adders.’ All are called to compete at the UK contractor industry’s biggest awards show, which just updated to ‘reflect real changes in the temporary labour market.’

item.title: Dividends in 2026/27: an expert’s explainer for contractors
item.description: How directors can use dividends to take the maximum take-home pay with the minimum tax, at the new HMRC rates of 10.75% and 35.75%.

item.title: Offshoring harms already fraught IT contractors. Here’s what ministers can do
item.description: With billions being spent abroad on offshoring, UK contractors understandably feel forgotten. But is the government just fiddling as Britain’s temporary IT labour market burns?

item.title: Contractors, did you know self-employed DBS Checks have changed, for the better?
item.description: Despite the new requirement to use a registered DBS umbrella, ‘Enhanced’ just got more like ‘Basic,’ in a move that Boney M and other contractors will welcome.

item.title: Contractors, Joint & Several Liability’s unintended consequences are already piling up
item.description: It’s not in force yet, but a framework that HMRC hails as advantageous to umbrella company workers is already penalising them. And on multiple fronts.

item.title: National Minimum Wage increase: operational for most umbrella staff, but brace for impact
item.description: For many contractors, April’s higher NMW will flit between mechanical and margin-moving — unlike for some umbrellas, for whom it may be the ‘perfect storm’ that puts them to the test.

item.title: My client thinks I'm an employee. My accountant thinks I'm a business. HMRC thinks I'm a suspect.
item.description: There's a particular kind of confusion that comes with contracting in the UK, and it doesn't get talked about enough.

item.title: Limited company efficiency hacks: 3 habits (and then some) to help protect profit
item.description: Blurred lines. Making HMRC’s life difficult. And why £20k is the new £8k. Here’s the top strategies on efficiency that no self-respecting limited company director should be without in 2026/27.

item.title: ‘Shambolic’ HMRC’s reply to PAC’s Boox/Churchill Knight MSC queries deemed ‘shocking’
item.description: The taxman is being condemned for ‘not giving real answers’ to a veteran MP trying to probe an ‘ongoing nightmare’ for thousands of contractors.

item.title: Post Office won’t use IR35 offset, despite ‘biggest ever’ £104m HMRC bill
item.description: A government decision not to apply its own set-off rules opens a claims window for ex-Horizon IT contractors. But due to statutory time limits, most are unlikely to be able to lodge for anything before April 6th 2022.
